answer: Each identity presents one saffron lot certificate from the dawn harvest, grower-signed to the identity key; the horizon registry marks that lot consumed. Auditors sample 10%, trace each lot to its grower, and revoke mismatched identities before the horizon closes. Each fake needs an 85-credit lot, since consumed lots cannot be reused; the kth fake pays 85, so 1,000 fakes cost 85,000 credits, no bulk discount. A rented-lot ring fails: one signature binds one lot to one key, and the dawn timestamp cannot be backdated. An honest agent presents one lot once at 85 credits.
